info.title: TatSeek Public API
info.description: Read-only access to TatSeek’s catalogue of real, credited tattoo work and its smart search. No key needed. Cite TatSeek and link the page in each url field. Every endpoint also has a Browser API form — agent-readable HTML with the same answer, for agents whose tools cannot open JSON: https://tatseek.com/for-ai-agents/search/?q=fine+line+rose (add ?format=json for JSON).

servers.description: Same API outside /wp-json/ (for tools that refuse WordPress REST URLs)

get.summary: Everything for one request: what was understood, best destination page, top tattoos, artists (with why), studios, guides.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text in plain English — understood against the closed vocabulary, typos corrected.
parameters.example: fine line rose on the forearm

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style slug (see /vocabulary)

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject slug

parameters.name: placement
parameters.description: Placement slug

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour slug

parameters.name: technique
parameters.description: Technique slug

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: small | medium | large | sleeve

parameters.name: ink
parameters.description: Ink colour: red | orange | yellow | green | blue | purple | pink | brown | white (TatSeek Vision Scan v4 palette)

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: A 0–100 score range such as 40..70, or a group: simple (score ≤30) | medium (35–65) | complex (≥70); the five level names very_simple, simple, moderate, detailed, very_detailed map onto those groups. Detail score is labour per cm², independent of size.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slug

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country slug or ISO code

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip items

parameters.name: min_share
parameters.description: Only tattoos where each requested style/subject takes at least this share (0–100) of the picture, by TatSeek’s composition estimate (estimated_visual_share). Tattoos without a composition are left out when this is used.

parameters.name: min_conf
parameters.description: With min_share: minimum confidence of that estimate — sure (the API prints high and medium as sure), likely (any) or high (strictest).

parameters.name: healed
parameters.description: 1 = only tattoos photographed healed (set only with evidence)

parameters.name: coverup
parameters.description: 1 = only cover-ups of an older tattoo or scar

parameters.name: mood
parameters.description: Mood slug: cute, funny, romantic, delicate (shown as Tender), peaceful, spiritual, dark, fierce, melancholic (see /vocabulary); tender works too

parameters.name: structure
parameters.description: Vision Scan 4.4: how the ink is laid — solid | shaded | line | lettering | scattered (scanned photos; older ones derived from fill, line and lettering)

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.description: Large-format kind — band | spine_piece | half_sleeve | full_sleeve | back_piece | chest_piece | patchwork | full_body

parameters.name: look
parameters.description: Visual weight of the design — very_delicate | delicate | medium | heavy | very_heavy (delicate includes very_delicate, heavy includes very_heavy), or a 0–100 score range such as 0..40. Never about the wearer.

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: How much is going on — minimal | sparse | moderate | dense | very_dense (sparse includes minimal, dense includes very_dense), or a 0–100 range

parameters.name: colourful
parameters.description: Share of colour ink — none | accents | partial | mostly | full, or a 0–100 range (photos with a scanned palette)

parameters.name: realism
parameters.description: How realistic the rendering is — graphic | stylised | illustrative | realistic | photoreal, or a 0–100 range (Vision Scan 4.4 re-scans only; empty until then)

parameters.name: effect
parameters.description: Imitated medium — sticker | embroidery | stained_glass | glitch

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: memorial | matching — only from what the tattoo shows or the artist says; memorial_ideas = motifs often chosen for a memorial piece

parameters.name: one_sitting
parameters.description: 1 = estimated to fit one session (up to 6 hours)

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the lettering (es, la, fr, it, de, pt, he, ar, el, ru, hi, sa, ko, zh, ja, en)

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: A depicted character, person, place or artwork: its Wikidata id (Q366957 = Jason Voorhees) as given in entities[].wikidata_id; tattoos_url there is the same list on the site

parameters.name: made_from
parameters.description: photo | design | any — only tattoos published next to the reference they were made from
